verses.en: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.pt: Filho meu, não te esqueças da minha instrução, e o teu coração guarde os meus mandamentos;
verses.en_web: My son, don’t forget my teaching; but let your heart keep my commandments:
verses.en_bbe: My son, keep my teaching in your memory, and my rules in your heart:

verses.en: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.pt: porque eles te darão longura de dias, e anos de vida e paz.
verses.en_web: for length of days, and years of life, and peace, will they add to you.
verses.en_bbe: For they will give you increase of days, years of life, and peace.

verses.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.pt: Não se afastem de ti a benignidade e a fidelidade; ata-as ao teu pescoço, escreve-as na tábua do teu coração;
verses.en_web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.en_bbe: Let not mercy and good faith go from you; let them be hanging round your neck, recorded on your heart;

verses.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.pt: assim acharás favor e bom entendimento à vista de Deus e dos homens.
verses.en_web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.en_bbe: So you will have grace and a good name in the eyes of God and men.

verses.en: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.pt: Confia no Senhor de todo o teu coração, e não te estribes no teu próprio entendimento.
verses.en_web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Put all your hope in God, not looking to your reason for support.

verses.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.pt: Reconhece-o em todos os teus caminhos, e ele endireitará as tuas veredas.
verses.en_web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verses.en_bbe: In all your ways give ear to him, and he will make straight your footsteps.

verses.en: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.pt: Não sejas sábio a teus próprios olhos; teme ao Senhor e aparta-te do mal.
verses.en_web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
verses.en_bbe: Put no high value on your wisdom: let the fear of the Lord be before you, and keep yourself from evil:

verses.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.pt: Isso será saúde para a tua carne; e refrigério para os teus ossos.
verses.en_web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.
verses.en_bbe: This will give strength to your flesh, and new life to your bones.

verses.en: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.pt: Honra ao Senhor com os teus bens, e com as primícias de toda a tua renda;
verses.en_web: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase:
verses.en_bbe: Give honour to the Lord with your wealth, and with the first-fruits of all your increase:

verses.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.pt: assim se encherão de fartura os teus celeiros, e trasbordarão de mosto os teus lagares.
verses.en_web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.en_bbe: So your store-houses will be full of grain, and your vessels overflowing with new wine.

verses.en: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.pt: Filho meu, não rejeites a disciplina do Senhor, nem te enojes da sua repreensão;
verses.en_web: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his reproof:
verses.en_bbe: My son, do not make your heart hard against the Lord's teaching; do not be made angry by his training:

verses.en: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.pt: porque o Senhor repreende aquele a quem ama, assim como o pai ao filho a quem quer bem.
verses.en_web: for whom Yahweh loves, he reproves; even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
verses.en_bbe: For to those who are dear to him the Lord says sharp words, and makes the son in whom he has delight undergo pain.

verses.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.pt: Feliz é o homem que acha sabedoria, e o homem que adquire entendimento;
verses.en_web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who makes discovery of wisdom, and he who gets knowledge.

verses.en: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.pt: pois melhor é o lucro que ela dá do que o lucro da prata, e a sua renda do que o ouro.
verses.en_web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
verses.en_bbe: For trading in it is better than trading in silver, and its profit greater than bright gold.

verses.en: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.pt: Mais preciosa é do que as jóias, e nada do que possas desejar é comparável a ela.
verses.en_web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.
verses.en_bbe: She is of more value than jewels, and nothing for which you may have a desire is fair in comparison with her.

verses.en: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.pt: Longura de dias há na sua mão direita; na sua esquerda riquezas e honra.
verses.en_web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.
verses.en_bbe: Long life is in her right hand, and in her left are wealth and honour.

verses.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.pt: Os seus caminhos são caminhos de delícias, e todas as suas veredas são paz.
verses.en_web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.
verses.en_bbe: Her ways are ways of delight, and all her goings are peace.

verses.en: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.pt: É árvore da vida para os que dela lançam mão, e bem-aventurado é todo aquele que a retém.
verses.en_web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.
verses.en_bbe: She is a tree of life to all who take her in their hands, and happy is everyone who keeps her.

verses.en: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.pt: O Senhor pela sabedoria fundou a terra; pelo entendimento estabeleceu o céu.
verses.en_web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord by wisdom put in position the bases of the earth; by reason he put the heavens in their place.

verses.en: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.pt: Pelo seu conhecimento se fendem os abismos, e as nuvens destilam o orvalho.
verses.en_web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.
verses.en_bbe: By his knowledge the deep was parted, and dew came dropping from the skies.

verses.en: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.pt: Filho meu, não se apartem estas coisas dos teus olhos: guarda a verdadeira sabedoria e o bom siso;
verses.en_web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.en_bbe: My son, keep good sense, and do not let wise purpose go from your eyes.

verses.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.pt: assim serão elas vida para a tua alma, e adorno para o teu pescoço.
verses.en_web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.
verses.en_bbe: So they will be life for your soul, and grace for your neck.

verses.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.pt: Então andarás seguro pelo teu caminho, e não tropeçará o teu pé.
verses.en_web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.
verses.en_bbe: Then you will go safely on your way, and your feet will have no cause for slipping.

verses.en: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.pt: Quando te deitares, não temerás; sim, tu te deitarás e o teu sono será suave.
verses.en_web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.en_bbe: When you take your rest you will have no fear, and on your bed sleep will be sweet to you.

verses.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.pt: Não temas o pavor repentino, nem a assolação dos ímpios quando vier.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes:
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear of sudden danger, or of the storm which will come on evil-doers:

verses.en: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor será a tua confiança, e guardará os teus pés de serem presos.
verses.en_web: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord will be your hope, and will keep your foot from being taken in the net.

verses.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.pt: Não negues o bem a quem de direito, estando no teu poder fazê-lo.
verses.en_web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep back good from those who have a right to it, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

verses.en: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.pt: Não digas ao teu próximo: Vai, e volta, amanhã to darei; tendo-o tu contigo.
verses.en_web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
verses.en_bbe: Say not to your neighbour, Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it by you at the time.

verses.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.pt: Não maquines o mal contra o teu próximo, que habita contigo confiadamente.
verses.en_web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not make evil designs against your neighbour, when he is living with you without fear.

verses.en: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.pt: Não contendas com um homem, sem motivo, não te havendo ele feito o mal.
verses.en_web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take up a cause at law against a man for nothing, if he has done you no wrong.

verses.en: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.pt: Não tenhas inveja do homem violento, nem escolhas nenhum de seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.
verses.en_bbe: Have no envy of the violent man, or take any of his ways as an example.

verses.en: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.pt: Porque o perverso é abominação para o Senhor, mas com os retos está o seu segredo.
verses.en_web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
verses.en_bbe: For the wrong-hearted man is hated by the Lord, but he is a friend to the upright.

verses.en: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.pt: A maldição do Senhor habita na casa do ímpio, mas ele abençoa a habitação dos justos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: The curse of the Lord is on the house of the evil-doer, but his blessing is on the tent of the upright.

verses.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.pt: Ele escarnece dos escarnecedores, mas dá graça aos humildes.
verses.en_web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.
verses.en_bbe: He makes sport of the men of pride, but he gives grace to the gentle-hearted.

verses.en: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.pt: Os sábios herdarão honra, mas a exaltação dos loucos se converte em ignomínia.
verses.en_web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
verses.en_bbe: The wise will have glory for their heritage, but shame will be the reward of the foolish.
